description:
Transform a multi-sheet Excel (.xlsx) into DMF-ready rows using a data-driven JSON
mapping -- equivalent to FO_TransformExcelForDMF. NO FO credentials required (offline
transform). Provide the workbook via ONE of: sourceUrl (Blob/SharePoint SAS URL or
Graph downloadUrl), filePath (local .xlsx) or fileContentBase64 (inline upload, small
files only). The mappingJson spec supports: sourceSheet, targetSheet, columnMappings
{source->target}, conditionalValues [{sourceColumn,matches[],values{}}], staticValues{},
deduplicateOn[] and autoGeneratedFields (array OR object keyed by sheet, e.g.
{"Products V2":["PRODUCTNUMBER"]}) which are removed so FO generates them.
Returns CSV (default, feed to dmf_import_file) or JSON (feed to odata_upsert_rows).
Set listSheetsOnly=true to just inspect the workbook's sheet names.

fileContentBase64.description: Base64-encoded .xlsx content (inline upload, small files). Provide one of sourceUrl/filePath/fileContentBase64.

filePath.description: Local path to a .xlsx file. Provide one of sourceUrl/filePath/fileContentBase64.

listSheetsOnly.description: If true, only list the workbook's sheet names (diagnostic). mappingJson not required.

mappingJson.description: Mapping spec JSON (columnMappings, conditionalValues, staticValues, deduplicateOn, autoGeneratedFields, sourceSheet). Optional when listSheetsOnly=true.

outputPath.description: Optional file path to also write the full transformed result to.

sheetName.description: Override the source sheet name. Empty = use mappingJson.sourceSheet, else the first sheet.

sourceUrl.description: URL to the .xlsx (Blob/SharePoint SAS or Graph downloadUrl). Provide one of sourceUrl/filePath/fileContentBase64.

name: dmf_transform_excel
